Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent illustrated wordmark for an existing trading-card header.
Input image 1 is the approved painted-gold mockup. Isolate ONLY its six gold letters "TRADER", spelled T R A D E R, from the red plaque.
Preserve the approved lettering faithfully: the softly flared sturdy Renaissance serif shapes, broad T and E bars, distinctive curved R legs, warm ochre-gold paint, pale-gold brush marks, slightly irregular hand-painted contours, original natural proportions and spacing. Do not redesign or typeset the letters. Preserve the very subtle warm edge shadow attached to each stroke.
Remove everything else: all red plaque, number 12, gold and black border, card frame, scenery, and character. All spaces between letters AND the counters inside R, A, D and R must be genuinely transparent. Clean antialiased alpha edges, with no residual red matte, white halo, checkerboard pattern, colored rectangle, backdrop, plaque, or presentation sheet.
Text (verbatim): "TRADER", exactly once on one straight horizontal baseline, fully inside the canvas, with no other content.
Output a wide landscape PNG with genuine transparent background. Keep the naturally wide and low proportions of the word in the reference; include transparent padding above and below rather than stretching it. This asset will render about 35–40 pixels tall on the existing red plaque.

assets.prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: transparent illustrated wordmark for the compact type header of a Lotería-inspired trading card.
Input image: the approved painted TRADER wordmark, used as the exact lettering style reference and edit target.
Primary request: replace TRADER with "ASSET", keeping the same painted serif lettering style, warm ochre/gold source color, brush texture, stroke weight, and slightly irregular sign-painted character. The card renderer applies the established cream finish to this gold source.
Text (verbatim): "ASSET". Spell exactly A - S - S - E - T. One word on one horizontal baseline.
Style: sturdy classical Roman serif capitals, broad wedge serifs, open counters, softly curved S forms, subtle pale brush highlights; flat painted pigment with restrained texture. Match the reference's A, E, and T letterforms faithfully.
Composition: wide horizontal wordmark with comfortable clear margins and all letters fully visible. Natural letter widths and spacing, no stretching. Include transparent padding above and below the word.
Background: genuinely transparent, with clean alpha around each letter and inside all counters. Output only the lettering.
Avoid: backdrop, plaque, border, card, illustration, flourishes, icons, extra text, gothic/blackletter forms, mosaic tiles, jewel effects, metallic bevel, drop shadow, glow, hazy halos, detached flecks.
assets.notes: Generated from the approved painted Trader lettering with built-in imagegen. Source alpha is preserved in lossless WebP. The active header uses the same cream finish as Trader and the subtypes; the earlier mosaic asset is retained for reference.

rendering.method: Shared IVORY_PAINT_MATRIX in wordmarkPaint.js; RGB only, original alpha unchanged
